summary_en: This Phase 2 study compares cabazitaxel with or without carboplatin against 177Lu-PSMA-617 in men with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer that is PSMA-positive. Cabazitaxel 20 mg/m2 is given as a one-hour IV infusion every three weeks, and carboplatin AUC 4 mg/mL/min is given every three weeks, each for up to 10 cycles or until progression or unacceptable toxicity. 177Lu-PSMA-617 7.4 GBq is given IV on Day 1 of each 6-week cycle for up to 6 cycles; the main outcome is not stated.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 compara cabazitaxel con o sin carboplatino frente a 177Lu-PSMA-617 en hombres con cáncer de próstata metastásico resistente a la castración que es positivo para PSMA. El cabazitaxel 20 mg/m2 se administra en infusión intravenosa de una hora cada tres semanas, y el carboplatino AUC 4 mg/mL/min se administra cada tres semanas, en ambos casos por hasta 10 ciclos o hasta progresión o toxicidad inaceptable. El 177Lu-PSMA-617 7.4 GBq se administra por vía intravenosa el Día 1 de cada ciclo de 6 semanas, por hasta 6 ciclos; el resultado principal no está indicado.
who_for: Prostate adenocarcinoma confirmed by pathology or cytology.
Metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer that progressed on an androgen receptor pathway inhibitor.
PSMA-positive on PET scan, with at least one site SUVmax 10 or higher.
Baseline PSMA SUVmean below 10, or visceral metastasis, or 5 or more bone metastases, or a TP53 or PTEN mutation.
Age over 18 years and ECOG performance status 0 to 2.
not_for: Evidence of small cell prostate cancer.
Another clinically significant malignancy within the previous 2 years, with listed exceptions.
Uncontrolled illness, or prior treatment toxicity not resolved to grade 2 or lower.
